back: A system that takes discrete inputs + internal state and produces discrete outputs
Combinational: no memory, output = f(inputs). Sequential: memory/state, output = f(inputs, state)
Synchronous: state changes at clock edges. Asynchronous: state can change any time
Analog: continuous in value & time. Digital: discrete (0/1)
Output 1 only if ALL inputs are 1. Y = AB. IC 7408
Output 1 if ANY input is 1. Y = A+B. IC 7432
Output 0 only when ALL inputs are 1. Y = (AB)'. IC 7400
Output 1 only when ALL inputs are 0. Y = (A+B)'. IC 7402
1 when inputs DIFFER. Y = A'B + AB'. IC 7486
1 when inputs are SAME (equality detector). Y = AB + A'B'
NOT, AND, OR (hence any function) can be built using only NAND (or only NOR)
1 NAND with both inputs tied: (AA)' = A'
3 NANDs: invert A, invert B, NAND them: (A'B')' = A+B
3 NORs: invert A, invert B, NOR them: (A'+B')' = AB
